newsitem.title: USA: SCAC Holdings agrees to buy patent rights.
newsitem.headline: SCAC Holdings agrees to buy patent rights.

text.p: SCAC Holdings Corp said Tuesday it agreed in principle to acquire patent rights to a new plastic replacement material from Solplax Ltd of Galway, Ireland.
The transaction, whose details are still being negotiated, will be completed by an issue of new SCAC Holdings stock.
It said the Solplax material is high in strength yet is biodegradable in water or when buried in a landfill. The product is nontoxic and approved by food use by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
SCAC said an independent audit of the product values the patent rights of Solplax in excess of $50 million.
Under the transaction, the board of SCAC will be reorganized and Michael Cunningham, currently chairman of Coach House Group UK will serve as SCAC chairman, replacing Nicholas McIlwraith.
